records.title: Electricity generation from non-conventional sources
details:
x: 1,54,830 MW Renewable Capacity including non-conventional energy
sources i.e. 64,670 MW of Solar, 6,490 MW of Wind and 59,990 MW Hybrid power
is under construction (till January 2026) while 47,920 MW of Renewable Capacity including non-conventional energy sources i.e. 35,440 MW of Solar and 10,080 MW Hybrid Power is at various stages of planning and targeted to be completed by 2029-30.

records.title: NHs IN MAHARASHTRA.
details: मैं उसका अध्ययन करके जल्द से जल्द यह काम शुरू कराऊंगा। रोड की बहुत खराब स्थिति है, तब तक उसकी मेंटीनेंस करके वह रोड राइडेबल रहेगी, ऐसी में जरूर कोशिश करूंगा।
